messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync: marketplace listing week - partners: OrionHW (hardware) + AxisSI (systems integrator). Need check: listing copy, partner assets, SI enablement, and legal signoff. Who owns what?
Owen (Marketing): I'll take listing copy + press timeline. Thinking embargo Thu 08:00 PT, partner blog same time. Need partner logo + 1-line quote by Wed 11:00 PT.
Priya (Product): I'll own SI enablement doc and a short 'deploy checklist' for OrionHW edge installs. Can we get a sample config from Orion by Tue?
Liam (Platform): Platform tasks: create marketplace SKU, wire analytics event, and provision partner sandbox. I can create sandbox keys today. ETA for keys: 90m. Also need to know billing price tier.
Sofia (Design): I'll design micro-landing and hero. Need high-res logos and a 3-frame gif showing hosted -> dedicated -> private. Send assets Wed 09:00 PT.
LegalBot: Reminder: logos require signed trademark form. Standard co-marketing agreement must be executed before publish. Send draft to legal@redwood.ai for review.
Maya (Partnerships): Action list: Owen copy (Wed EOD), Priya SI doc (Wed noon), Liam sandbox + SKU (keys in 90m), Sofia assets (Wed 09:00), Partners: logos + quote (Wed 11:00). Please ack.
Owen (Marketing): ack :thumbsup: I'll draft a partner-facing email to collect quotes + speaker names.
Priya (Product): ack. I'll ping Orion for the config today.
Liam (Platform): ack. Sandbox keys will be posted to #secure-ops once generated, and I'll DM partner test endpoint.
Sofia (Design): ack. Reserving Wed morning for asset polish.
LegalBot: Noted. Please attach signed usage forms; I'll expedite review if received by Wed 12:00 PT.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks — I'll compile this into an Asana checklist and send invites for Wed dry-run at 10:30 PT.
Liam (Platform): Posted sandbox keys to #secure-ops. Endpoint: https://sandbox.redwood.ai/partners/orionhw-test (do not share publicly).
Owen (Marketing): I'll schedule the embargo for Thu 08:00 PT and draft PR pitch.
Maya (Partnerships): Great team. If logos/quotes miss Wed window we'll fallback with generic "partner coming soon" badge and adjust the timeline. Meeting invite sent.
